Beginning of Wave 19 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Get ready for a boss!|Beginning of Wave 14 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Necromancer''' was a summoner enemy that had the ability to spawn enemies every five seconds, which only appears in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. The enemies it can spawn are the [[Hidden]], [[Slow]], [[Speedy]] and [[Normal]], which are mainly used to focus towers away from the '''Necromancer'''. These summoned enemies do not give money when damaged. The '''Necromancer''' is slightly slower than the [[Slow]] and has the same speed as the [[Slow Boss]]. The '''Necromancer''' can be spawned by the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death in [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode. The '''Necromancer''' also appeared in [[The Heights]] as part of the [[SFOTH Event]]. It could have been spawned by the [[Swordmaster]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Necromancer''' has grey skin, a twisted left leg and walks hunchbacked. It is faceless with pink glowing eyes. It wears a black cloak and its torso and legs are wool black. It has grey diamond-plated shoes and chains are wrapped around its arms. It has two large black shoulder-pads and a black hood. It holds a summoning staff with a purple orb on top. |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Necromancer''' is similar to the fourth version, except it had a drooling zombie face with pink glowing eyes. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Necromancer''' had a ripped black cloak. It has grey skin, glowing blue eyes and a drooling zombie face. It was slightly taller than the [[Normal Boss]]. Its torso was grey, had black legs, black sleeves, grey skull shoulder-pads with black eyes and a brown hood. It wielded a staff that summoned enemies. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Necromancer''' had grey skin, glowing blue eyes and a drooling zombie face. Its torso and legs were black, had black sleeves, grey skull shoulder-pads and a brown hood. It wielded a green skull staff that summoned enemies. }} ==Strategy== As this enemy no longer appears naturally, strategy for its most recent intentional appearance will be listed instead. *The '''Necromancer''' spawns many enemies, making splash damage towers, such as the [[Demoman]], [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]], pretty effective against the '''Necromancer''' and the enemies that are summoned. **If the '''Necromancer''' can get past your main towers, and there are no defenses near the end of the path, these enemies can reduce your base health significantly. *Multiple early-game towers that deal high DPS, like the [[Militant]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Cowboy]], can easily kill the '''Necromancer'''. **You can also save up money for a mid-game tower, like the [[Ranger]] and [[Minigunner]]. ***These towers can be set to ''Strongest'' to attack the '''Necromancer''' first, but this may risk summoned enemies getting past your defenses. *The [[Gladiator]] can be quite useful against the '''Necromancer''' as it can kill the enemies that spawn, as well as damaging the '''Necromancer''' at the same time. **The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Shotgunner]] are more advanced examples of this. *The summoned enemies do not give money when damaged. **However, the [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] can still generate money from them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} OlderNecromancer0.png|Third version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) Necromancer.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) NecromancerOriginal.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyNecro.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} LegacyNecromancerWalk.gif|Current walk animation (14 June 2019 – Present) LegacyNecromancerSummon.gif|Current ''Summon'' animation (14 June 2019 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} OldStyle0.png|'''Necromancer''' on the game icon.
